'''Xuc''' was an individual who lived during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Xuc was the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] of the [[Kingdom of Argai]], and the brother of [[Xic]], [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], [[Xom]] and [[Xil]]. According to the play ''[[The Pirate Prince]]'', which was made by the [[Lisst'n]] dramatist [[Lyechusas]], the existence of Xuc, Xil, Xom and Xic was kept secret from Xim. When Xer eventually introduced Xim to his brothers while on [[Argai]], Xim killed Xuc, Xil, Xom and Xic, so that he wouldn't have to share Xer's wealth with them. Xer was overcome with grief, so Xim killed his father as well and then made himself the new king.
